parameters.query:
SELECT b.id, b.website_url
FROM businesses b
LEFT JOIN web_audit a ON a.business_id = b.id
WHERE b.website_type = 'real'
  AND (a.business_id IS NULL OR a.audited_at < now() - interval '90 days')
ORDER BY b.review_count DESC
LIMIT 100;
